description: Whole-application route tables (30-80 routes each) where precedence between many siblings matters: framework file routes, route rules, middleware scopes and reserved names translated into rou3 patterns
sources: README: Route patterns, Wildcards, Groups, Matching, Result ordering (detailed rules), Routes for any method, Trailing slashes and empty segments, Path normalization
.agents/matching.md: same-node siblings, method-agnostic entries, segments after a catch-all (rankFromEnd), empty segments
Nuxt pages/ + server/ + routeRules conventions (nuxt.com/docs/guide/concepts/rendering#route-rules), Nitro /**/_payload.json
GitHub web URL layout (github.com/:owner/:repo/{tree,blob,raw}/:ref/:path, issues, pull, compare, releases, archive)
Next.js pages/app router dynamic segments ([slug], [...slug], [[...slug]]), _next/static, _next/data/:buildId/*.json, middleware matcher
Hono routing docs (app.use('/api/*'), /wild/*/card, :date{[0-9]+}) and Express 5 / path-to-regexp v8 (*splat, {optional})

scenarios.name: nuxt app: pages, server api and route rules in one router
scenarios.description: Nuxt/Nitro: method-agnostic routeRules (`/**` defaults, `/api/**` cors, `/admin/**` auth, `/blog/**` ISR, `/_nuxt/**` immutable, `/**/_payload.json`), pages (`[slug].vue` -> `:slug`, `[...slug].vue` -> `**:slug`, `docs/[[...slug]].vue` -> `:slug*`, `@[username].vue` -> `@:username`) and server/api handlers with methods. Rules and handlers share nodes, so the method-agnostic-vs-method tie rule and the from-end ranking of `/**/_payload.json` are both exercised.

scenarios.name: github-like web app: reserved top-level names vs /:owner/:repo
scenarios.description: GitHub URL layout: reserved statics (`/settings`, `/login`, `/new`, `/explore`, `/orgs/:org`) beat `/:owner` only at their own depth; refs and file paths (`tree/:ref/**:path`, `blob`, `raw`), numeric issue / PR ids (`:number(\d+)` vs `issues/new`), commit shas, `*.zip` archives of slashed refs, and `:repo.git` smart-HTTP endpoints.

cases.note: from-end ranking: the suffix route pins the last segment, so it beats the reserved /settings/** scope (README: Segments after a catch-all)

scenarios.name: e-commerce storefront: locale prefix group, slug-id products, deep categories
scenarios.description: Storefront in the style of Nuxt i18n `prefix_except_default` and Shopware/Magento URLs: an optional `{/:locale(de|fr|es)}?` prefix, `/c/**:path` categories, `/p/:slug-:id(\d+)` products next to a legacy `/p/:slug`, CMS pages at `/:page` competing with the locale home, cart and checkout with method routes, method-agnostic checkout/account guards, media files `/media/*.:ext(jpg|png|webp)` and `/sitemap-:n(\d+).xml`.

scenarios.name: docs site: versions, raw markdown, meta files and redirects
scenarios.description: VitePress/Docusaurus/Nextra-style docs: `/docs/:version(v\d+|latest)?/**:slug` pages, a version index, raw markdown at `/docs/**.md`, `/docs/**/_meta.json`, a static `/docs/v1/**` redirect that beats the version param, API reference with scoped packages (`@:scope/:pkg`), hashed assets `/:name.:hash.js` and `/v:major(\d+)` shortcuts. The two suffix routes rank from the end of the path over the docs catch-all.

cases.note: listed once (`/docs/**:slug` and `/docs/:version/**:slug` match), with findRoute's params

scenarios.name: api gateway: upstream proxy, overrides and a deny-list
scenarios.description: Gateway in the style of Kong/Traefik/Nitro proxy rules: method-agnostic `/svc/:service/**` upstream proxy, gateway-owned health checks, method-specific overrides (`POST /svc/payments/charges`, cached `GET /svc/users/:id(\d+)`), a rate-limit scope, and deny rules for internal paths (`/internal/**`, `/admin/**`, `/actuator/**` with an allowed `actuator/health`, `/.git/**`, `/**/.env` anywhere). Encoded slashes, doubled slashes, case and unresolved `..` are NOT denied: rou3 never decodes or collapses paths (README), so a gateway must normalize first; the cases pin that.

scenarios.name: multi-tenant saas: tenant scope, settings guard, files and webhooks
scenarios.description: Multi-tenant app (Rails/Laravel/SvelteKit-style `/t/[tenant]/...`): a method-agnostic tenant middleware, `projects/new` vs `projects/:projectId`, optional tabs, a settings role guard over `/settings/:section?` and a static `billing`, file storage `files/**:path` with a `files/**:path/download` suffix route, webhooks restricted to known providers, admin and API scopes, and long invite tokens.

scenarios.name: next.js app: catch-all and optional catch-all segments
scenarios.description: Next.js routes translated: `[id]` -> `:id`, `[...slug]` -> `:slug+`, `[[...slug]]` -> `:slug*`, `[...nextauth]` method-agnostic, `_next/static/**:path`, `_next/data/:buildId/*.json`, `/u/[id]-[slug]` as `:id(\d+){-:slug}?`. Static siblings (`/shop/cart`, `/posts/new`) beat dynamic ones only at their own depth. The middleware matcher `/((?!api|_next).*)` (look-ahead) has no rou3 equivalent and is rejected.

scenarios.name: hono / express app: `*` middleware scopes
scenarios.description: Hono `app.use('/api/*', cors())` and `app.use('*', logger())` scopes as method-agnostic `*` routes, which cover their own prefix (`/api`) since a trailing `*` is optional; Hono's `/wild/*/card` and `:date{[0-9]+}` (-> `:date(\d+)`); Express 5 `/files/*splat` (-> `**:splat`) and `/ab{cd}e` (-> `/ab{cd}?e`); `serveStatic` under `/static/*` with a typed-image sibling `/static/*.:ext(png|jpg|svg)` ranked from the end.
